name: Lin'
source:
An employee of the Chinese branch of the N. corporation and a well-known professor of cybernetics, Feng Lin, becomes disillusioned with life. She finishes her project on consciousness digitizing, conducts experiment on herself and committes suicide. Howether, life in the network was not as rosy as she imagined. Ultimately, Lin' realized that she made ​​a huge mistake, putting herself in a callous digital world.
For a long time, Lin' was trying to find a way out. And that's when she learns about a certain student in search of behavioral core for his actroid.
